query: What praise and complaints appear in IMDb reviews?

per_column.name: praise_count
per_column.rationale: The volume of praise is a constitutive aspect of the praise-and-complaints concept, capturing the 'praise' side quantitatively as a part of the whole.

per_column.name: complaint_count
per_column.rationale: The volume of complaints is a constitutive aspect of the concept, capturing the 'complaints' side quantitatively as a part of the whole.

per_column.name: praised_aspects
per_column.rationale: Identifies WHICH aspects (acting, plot, etc.) are praised -- a constitutive content-facet of the praise dimension, an aspect-of the concept.

per_column.name: complained_aspects
per_column.rationale: Identifies which aspects are complained about -- a constitutive content-facet of the complaint dimension, an aspect-of the concept.

per_column.name: review_sentiment_type
per_column.rationale: This categorizes the review as predominantly_praise / predominantly_complaint / mixed / neutral, which is a summary label re-derived from the balance of praise vs complaint already captured by the count columns. It restates the whole concept rather than decomposing it into a distinct part.

judge.rationale: The concept 'audience_praise_and_complaints' decomposes naturally into two polarity sides (praise, complaint), each with a volume dimension (counts) and a content/aspect dimension (which topics). The four count/aspect columns are genuine constitutive facets and cover both polarity x (volume, content) cells fairly well, giving reasonable exhaustiveness. Mutual exclusivity is somewhat reduced because review_sentiment_type is a restatement derived from the same praise/complaint balance the counts already encode, overlapping rather than carving a new aspect. Missing constitutive dimensions such as intensity/strength of the sentiment and specific evaluative expressions keep exhaustiveness below full.
